usage: The word '蜥蜴' (sik1 jik6) refers to a type of reptile commonly known as a lizard.
'蜥蜴' is a noun and can be used to talk about the animal itself or a pet lizard.
You can use '蜥蜴' in simple sentences to talk about owning, seeing, or describing a lizard.
It can be combined with verbs like '有' (jau5, have), '買' (maai5, buy), or '睇' (tai2, see) in everyday speech.
In questions, you can ask '你有冇蜥蜴？' to mean 'Do you have a lizard?'
